channel.title: The Daily Digest
channel.description: One top story from each of my chosen publications, updated daily.

item.title: NYT: Paramount to Resolve Antitrust Lawsuit, Clearing the Way for Warner Bros. Acquisition
item.description: The deal would remove the last significant hurdle the media mogul David Ellison faced to create a news and entertainment empire, home to movie studios, HBO, CBS and CNN.

item.title: NPR: World leaders convene for UNGA. And, Trump says D.C. arch will be a 'military complex'
item.description: This week, world leaders convene for the U.N. General Assembly as war continues in Ukraine and the Gulf. And, President Trump has proposed that his arch serve as a military complex.

item.title: BBC News: Airlines criticise air traffic control as second glitch causes more disruption
item.description: Airlines are angry about the delays, with EasyJet saying the latest incident "once again calls into question the resilience" of the system.

item.title: Al Jazeera: Antonio Guterres: Can the UN still meet today’s global crises?
item.description: Al Jazeera’s James Bays sits down with United Nations Secretary-General Antonio Guterres.

item.title: Ars Technica: Review: Neagley is a worthy spinoff to megahit Reacher
item.description: It's a bit uneven in execution but still delivers as fast-paced, entertaining escapist fare.

item.title: WIRED Backchannel: Women Still Face Too Much Bullshit—in Silicon Valley and Beyond
item.description: WIRED dedicating an entire issue to women in 2026 might seem regressive, or obvious, or even unnecessary. We disagree.

item.title: WIRED Science: After 8 Years in Space, ‘BepiColombo’ Is Finally Approaching Mercury
item.description: Following a difficult journey, the probe will soon begin unravelling the mysteries of Mercury’s magnetic field and internal structure.

item.title: The New Yorker: The Lost Descendants of Thomas Jefferson
item.description: Scientists have new proof that the President had children with his enslaved chambermaid Sally Hemings—and that their bloodline endures across the country.

item.title: New York Mag The Cut: Patrick Clancy and His Wife Are Starting a Family
item.description: “I can’t wait to tell them about their brothers and sister,” he said of their future child.
